title: Python: a table written in a block content control inside a table cell has no handle
symptom: Cell.tables lists the tables written directly in a cell, and Cell.paragraphs does not list the paragraphs of a table, so no Python handle reaches a table written in a block content control of a cell (as Google Docs writes one); Rust Document::story_tables of the cell story lists it
workaround: name it by its location, ContentLocation(cell_story, "table", (c, k)) with c the control's story item index, in clone_content, move_content, pop_content and insert_content, or replace its text with Cell.replace_text
